title: Education Benefits Held Under More Than One Chapter
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 1 — Benefit records per beneficiary (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**1.01 Rule.** A beneficiary may hold education benefits under more than one chapter — for example the Selected Reserve Montgomery GI Bill earned in the Reserve and the Post-9/11 GI Bill earned on active duty, or Chapter 35 as a child and a chapter earned through the beneficiary's own service. There is no fixed limit on the number of chapters a beneficiary may hold, but the beneficiary holds at most one benefit record per chapter, and a change of Post-9/11 benefit level updates that existing record rather than opening another.

**1.02 Condition for establishing a record.** A benefit record is established only when the beneficiary holds no benefit record under the same official tier. The test is made on the system's benefit records before the record is established, matching the same beneficiary and the same official tier name; a record counts as held whatever its state — active, exhausted, delimited or relinquished. What the caller says about the benefits they hold does not replace the records.

**1.03 Points of judgement**

| Records already held by the beneficiary | Record proposed | May it be established under 1.02 |
|---|---|---|
| None | Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | Yes |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35), exhausted | Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | Yes — a different tier |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606), relinquished | Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | No — a record under the same tier is held, relinquished records included |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level, active | Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | No — the same tier is already held |

*Hypothetical note:* when added qualifying service moves a beneficiary from the 70% to the 80% Benefit Level, the existing Post-9/11 record is updated to the new level under 1.01; no second Post-9/11 record is opened.
